is_ticket.description: true only for a flight ticket, e-ticket, itinerary, booking confirmation or boarding pass

reason.description: one sentence: what the document is

booking_reference.description: PNR / booking reference as printed, or null

flight_number.description: airline code + number, no spaces, e.g. QR4793

origin.description: 3-letter IATA code of the departure airport

destination.description: 3-letter IATA code of the arrival airport

departure_local.description: local departure time as printed, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

arrival_local.description: local arrival time as printed, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or null if not printed

terminal.description: departure terminal as printed, or null

gate.description: gate as printed, or null (usually null on tickets)

confidence.description: 0.0–1.0 confidence that every field above was clearly printed

notes.description: anything inferred, unclear, or missing; empty string if nothing
